x_pc.additionalInfo: PC recalls presets 0-126; PC also saves when in save mode. CC27 value selects the save slot.
PC loads preset 1-127; in Save Mode (hold TAP), PC saves to slot 1-127
PC loads preset 1-127; in Save Mode (hold Vibe LED), PC saves to slot 1-127
PC loads preset 1-127; in Save Mode (hold SWIRL), PC saves to slot 1-127
PC loads preset 1-127; in Save Mode (hold TAP), PC saves to slot 1-127
PC 0-103 selects AM4 presets A1-Z4. AM4 does not transmit or respond to bank select.
Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select AX8 presets 1:1 through 64:8
Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select Axe-Fx III presets 0-511. Axe-Fx III Mark II extends this map to 1024 presets using CC0 values 0-7.
Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select FM3 presets 0-511.
Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select FM9 presets 0-511.
PC 0-127 selects FX8 presets A1-P8; FX8 does not transmit or respond to bank select
PC 0-103 selects VP4 presets A1-Z4. VP4 does not transmit or respond to bank select.
PC 0-30 recalls presets. Save via SysEx, TouchOSC, or hold HOLD+ON footswitches then send PC.

Aeros opens songs using CC0 MSB plus PC, in that order. LSB CC32 is not relevant for Aeros song select. The song must first be opened manually and saved with MIDI Song Select enabled to assign the MSB/PC combination.

Default song select uses Bank Select MSB CC0, LSB CC32, and PC. MSB selects the bank, LSB selects the folder within the bank, and PC selects the song within the current folder. If only PC is sent, it opens the corresponding song in the current folder.

Default song select uses Bank Select MSB CC0, LSB CC32, and PC. MSB selects the bank, LSB selects the folder within the bank, and PC selects the song within the current folder. Aeros Mode uses MSB and PC only; LSB is ignored.
